deepDive: Posterior predictive checks simulate data from the fitted model and compare it with observed patterns. They test whether the model can reproduce important features, not whether the model is “true.” Good fit on one summary can hide poor fit elsewhere. Model checking should inform revision. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Simulate purchase counts from a fitted model and compare zero frequency and tail behavior with actual data.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
